verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a homepage claim that marketers can 'see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue.' That suggests some first-party per-email conversion and revenue attribution. Nothing in the pack documents open, click, or unsubscribe metrics, breakdowns per campaign versus per workflow step, or time-series reporting. Missing for 10: open/click/unsubscribe reporting, per-automation-step metrics, per-campaign analytics docs, over-time trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: See which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue.
